objective_2_proton_windows_client_explic.method_note: Loopback targets are unusable for this test: WinHTTP bypasses the proxy for loopback, and Wine did not honour the '<-loopback>' bypass override. Non-loopback documentation addresses (RFC 5737) were used instead.

objective_4_mcc_explicit_proxy.observed_side_effect: Xbox Live sign-in failed while traffic was routed through the proxy

objective_5_transparent_redirect.reason: Stage D runs only if explicit proxying does not reach MCC. It did reach MCC (objective 4), so no DNS redirection was created and /etc/hosts was never modified.

objective_6_mcc_certificate_acceptance.reason: Every connection MCC made through the proxy was to a host on the hard-exclusion list and was therefore blind-tunnelled by design. No MCC connection was ever TLS-terminated with the test CA, so acceptance, rejection, and pinning were all left untested. This is a deliberate consequence of the exclusions, not a failure.
